name: gemini_standard_query
description: Send a prompt to Google Gemini and get a text response. Supports system_instruction, temperature, max_tokens, and model override. Default model: gemini-2.5-flash.

name: gemini_structured_extractor
description: Extract JSON from a prompt using a JSON Schema. Returns {json, raw, usage}. Uses Gemini's native responseSchema mode for guaranteed schema-conformant output.

name: gemini_code_execution_engine
description: Ask Gemini to solve a problem by writing and executing Python in a sandboxed environment. Returns the answer plus executable_code and execution_result blocks. Great for math, data analysis, and verification tasks.

name: gemini_grounded_query
description: Query Gemini with Google Search grounding enabled. Returns the answer plus grounding_metadata and citations from real web sources. Use when factual freshness matters.

name: gemini_analyze_media
description: Upload a media file (image, audio, video, or PDF) via base64 or file_path and ask Gemini a question about it. Uses the Files API and supports the full 1M-token multimodal context.

name: gemini_generate_image
description: Generate one or more images from a text prompt using Imagen (default: imagen-3.0-generate-002). Saves each image to output_path and returns the saved file paths.

name: gemini_spatial_analysis
description: Detect objects in an image and return JSON bounding boxes normalized to a 0-1000 grid: [{label, box_2d:[ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax]}]. Supply file_base64 or file_path plus an optional target_objects hint.

name: gemini_text_to_speech
description: Synthesize speech from text using Gemini native TTS (default model: gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts). Writes the audio to output_path. Voice defaults to 'Kore'.

name: gemini_generate_embeddings
description: Generate text embeddings using text-embedding-004 (or any embedding model). Accepts a single string or an array (uses batchEmbedContents for arrays). Returns the vector(s) plus dimensions.

name: gemini_cache_document
description: Create a Gemini context cache for a large document or system instruction. Returns cache_name to reuse across subsequent generateContent calls for major cost savings. Requires a billing-enabled GCP project.

name: gemini_batch_processor
description: Process an array of prompts in parallel with bounded concurrency (default 4). Returns per-prompt {ok, text, usage|error}. Client-side fan-out — works on any tier.

name: gemini_deep_research_start
description: Submit a server-side batchGenerateContent long-running operation for large-scale or background work. Returns operation_name to poll with gemini_deep_research_status.

name: gemini_deep_research_status
description: Poll the status of a long-running Gemini operation by operation_name. Returns {done, metadata, response, error}.

name: gemini_cancel_batch_job
description: Cancel a running Gemini long-running operation. Falls back to DELETE if :cancel is rejected. Returns the final operation state.

name: gemini_list_models
description: Enumerate available Gemini models with display_name, version, input/output token limits, and supported generation methods. Useful for model discovery before using other gemini_* tools.

name: gemini_chat
description: Send a multi-turn conversation history to Gemini and get the next assistant reply. Pass messages as [{role, text}] array; returns updated_messages array ready for the next turn. Supports system instructions, temperature, and max_tokens.

name: gemini_function_call
description: Call Gemini with tool/function definitions and get back either a text response or a structured function call request. Supports tool_choice mode (AUTO, ANY, NONE) to control when Gemini uses tools.

tools.description: Function declarations: [{name, description, parameters: {type, properties, required}}]

tool_choice.description: AUTO=Gemini decides, ANY=force tool use, NONE=text only

name: gemini_count_tokens
description: Count tokens for a prompt or conversation before sending to Gemini, to verify it fits within the model context window. Returns total_tokens count so you can compare against the model limit before making an expensive request.

contents.description: Raw contents array for multi-turn token counting

name: gemini_analyze_image_url
description: Analyze an image at a public URL using Gemini vision — no file upload needed. Fetches the image bytes directly and passes them inline to Gemini. Faster than gemini_analyze_media for small public images.

name: gemini_edit_image
description: Edit an existing image using Imagen's inpainting and editing capabilities. Provide the source image (file_path or file_base64), an optional mask for targeted edits, and a text prompt describing the change. Returns the edited image saved to output_path.

prompt.description: Description of the edit to make

mask_base64.description: Optional base64 mask — white=edit area, black=keep

name: gemini_list_files
description: List files previously uploaded to the Gemini Files API. Returns file names, URIs, MIME types, sizes, processing states, and expiration times. Files expire after 48 hours unless refreshed.

name: gemini_get_file
description: Get metadata and status for a specific file uploaded to the Gemini Files API by its file name (e.g. 'files/abc123'). Check the state field — ACTIVE means ready to use; PROCESSING means still uploading.

name: gemini_delete_file
description: Delete a file from the Gemini Files API by its file name. Frees up quota. Files are automatically deleted after 48 hours, but use this for immediate cleanup or to remove sensitive content.

name: gemini_list_cached_contents
description: List all cached content entries created with gemini_cache_document. Returns cache names, associated models, creation times, and expiration times. Use to audit active caches and their TTLs.

name: gemini_delete_cached_content
description: Delete a specific cached content entry from the Gemini context cache by its cache name. Use after processing is done or to free up quota. Cache names come from gemini_cache_document or gemini_list_cached_contents.

name: gemini_query_with_cache
description: Query Gemini using a previously cached document context as a prefix. Dramatically reduces token costs when repeatedly querying against the same large document or codebase. cache_name comes from gemini_cache_document.

name: gemini_thinking_query
description: SUPER TOOL: Send a complex multi-step reasoning task to Gemini 2.5 Pro with extended thinking enabled. The model reasons through the problem step-by-step before answering. Returns both the thinking process and the final answer. Best for math, logic, code review, and research synthesis.

thinking_budget.description: Max thinking tokens (0=disable, -1=dynamic/unlimited, or a specific number)

name: gemini_transcribe_video
description: Transcribe or analyze a video file using Gemini's multimodal vision capabilities. Uploads the video to the Files API, waits for processing, then generates a timestamped transcript or answers a custom prompt about the video content.

name: gemini_multi_speaker_tts
description: Generate multi-speaker audio with different voices for each speaker using Gemini's native TTS. Pass an array of {speaker, text, voice} turns and get back a single audio file with natural voice switching between speakers. Ideal for dialogue, podcasts, or narration.

turns.description: Array of {speaker: string, text: string, voice?: string} — voice defaults to Kore/Charon/Fenrir/Aoede in rotation

name: gemini_document_ocr
description: Extract text from a scanned document, image, or PDF using Gemini vision. Supports three output formats: plain text (default), Markdown (preserves structure and headings), or JSON (structured sections). Automatically uses the Files API for documents larger than 20MB.

name: gemini_compare_documents
description: Upload two documents to Gemini and compare them side-by-side — identifying differences, similarities, and key changes. Useful for contract redlining, policy diff analysis, or comparing report versions. Supports PDF, images, and any Gemini-supported format.
